# Velair 1.9.0-beta.11

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Planned Return now hands unavailable or missing climates to background recovery without repeatedly scheduling an already-due preparation. Recovery follows the current intention, including after arrival, while other climates continue independently. Thanks to [GuiPoM](https://community.home-assistant.io/u/guipom) for the detailed report, related to [issue #62](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/62).
- Weekly early starts waiting for a settings save now resume after commit or rollback without repeatedly waking the scheduler or delaying unrelated zones.
- Bursts of external climate changes preserve manual observations while avoiding obsolete Keep automatic corrections. Room Assist retains pending sensor updates during slow delivery and shares one background worker.
- Repeated temperature-migration events no longer recreate unchanged successful notifications. Failed notification operations can recover on a later event.
- Comfort can now use the climate's native temperature as the optional backup when its preferred source is the configured external room sensor, including **Use automatic source**. Choosing native temperature clears the backup option; humidity keeps its existing explicit-source rule. Thanks to **@scastiello** for [issue #71](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/71).

## 🚀 Improved

- Fully linked day previews share a full-day request, Profile summaries reuse prepared draft inputs, and Planned Return checks avoid repeatedly copying the household plan. Draft changes, stale-response checks and explicit retries remain supported.
- Added regression coverage for deferred recovery, save completion, event bursts, worker cancellation, notification failures and shared previews. Updated developer contracts and manual validation scenarios.
- Updated the Comfort backup guide and clarified its explanation and temperature-backup accessibility label in all nine maintained non-English languages.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.10](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.10). Storage and portable export formats are unchanged; portable exports remain model 26. Comfort backups remain opt-in and disabled by default for existing configurations.
- These fixes address reproducible scheduling and event-processing cases. They are not benchmark results and do not establish that the reported installation's CPU incident is resolved. Real Home Assistant and physical-device recovery validation remain pending.
- All maintained guide translations match their current English sources. They remain identified as AI-assisted, without qualified human linguistic review.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
